title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Prepositions of Place
description: Show what you learned about prepositions of place. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use in, on, at, under, behind, in front of for location.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: The garden is behind the house.
The garden is behind the house.
The garden WRONG behind the house.
questions.answer: The garden is behind the house.
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Prepositions of Place: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address

questions.question: Complete: The garden ___ behind the house.
questions.explanation: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address

questions.question: True or false: "The garden is behind the house." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: The car ___ in front of the building.
questions.explanation: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address
